statutory.answer: The facts are neutral as to whether 31 U.S.C. § 5318(g) requires a report.

There are no indicators of illicit origin, structuring, or unusual patterns that would trigger a 'suspicious' determination. Because the facts do not provide evidence of suspicious activity, it is unclear if 31 U.S.C. § 5318(g) requires a report.
